sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one appears for the informant despite notice.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.48 of 2024 under sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and section 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. Maheshganj, District Pratapgarh.
3. In terms of the FIR, a missing person report was lodged alleging that the daughter of the informant was enticed away by the applicant.

Subsequently, in the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she had gone out of her own Anil Kumar Sonkar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38534874/
1 free will.

entities.text: Anil Kumar Sonkar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She also expressed his consent to form the physical relations.
The tentative age of the victim has been assessed as 17 years as per the radio-logical examination.
4. Considering the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., the applicant who is in custody since 07.04.2024 and has no criminal history, he is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Anil Kumar Sonkar be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.7.2024 VNP/-
